import pandas as pd

# Locate the row for "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == "deaths outside of prisons & camps"]

# Year columns are all columns except the first (Description) and last (Total)
year_cols = df.columns[1:-1]

# Convert year columns to numeric
vals = row[year_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").iloc[0]

# Find the year with the maximum value
answer = vals.idxmax()
